trigger.name: August 2026 spam update
trigger.evidence: Google's Search Status Dashboard marks the August 2026 spam update Closed. Complete data through August 26 still fails the release test: the property is at 6 clicks and 1,794 impressions versus 26 and 4,442, while Network, Smarthome and Pets page-detail impressions remain down about 92.7%, 97.1% and 98.9%. Production, sitemap, current canonical, manual-action and security checks remain healthy, and the exact 486-URL inspection queue is complete at 471 indexed and 15 not on Google. The freeze therefore remains an evidence-backed search-exposure control rather than an outage response.

freeze.releaseRule: Three complete post-close Search Console days are now available, but their exact host evidence does not support release. Keep new indexable expansion frozen until a later exact cohort gate shows recovery; calendar time alone never unfreezes the portfolio. Owner-authorized, query-backed repairs to existing pages may proceed with a changed-URL ledger and full validation.
